notes:
- The Iris Client HUD stays on screen with hitboxes (F3+B) or chunk borders on. It used to vanish with ping, FPS and everything else.
- New Ranks page. Get tier tested in Sword, UHC, Bow, Axe, Crystal, Pot, Netherite Pot, Mace, Elytra Mace, Spear Mace or SMP, from level 1 to 3.
- Every level has its own title, from Recruit to Sword Master. Harry Potter (P4) and True Mace Master (M4) unlock once their kits are all at level 3.
- My rank shows your nametag the way other players see it. Click a rank you hold to put it in your nametag, like S3 or P4, or hide it.
- Leaderboards for every kit and overall. Higher levels come first, and among equal levels whoever was ranked first stays on top.
- Ghostlex_ and 99qooo test players in the tier tester panel. Only those two accounts can set ranks, the rank service checks it with Mojang.
- PvP ranks show in game in the colour of their level. PvP ranks in the Right Shift menu switches them off.
- A clean Ranks page: kit cards fill the width, a short guide shows how to get your first rank, and empty leaderboards say what comes next.
- A cleaner sidebar: the pages sit in four groups, the rows are slimmer, and your account is one small card with sign out as an icon.
- The Play page shows what is new in this version, and update notes are proper bullet lists.
- The Ranks page is on Linux and macOS too.
